summary: Regression testing of the Mobile (Expo web) Merchant Scan QR fixes for PDF/Print/Share/WhatsApp/booking-link parity. Backend (4 endpoints) + Frontend (Expo web at http://localhost:8081) both pass 100%.

frontend_checks.onboarding->demo-merchant->tab-scanqr fl: PASS (no red overlay, no runtime crash)
frontend_checks.hero-link equals `${EXPO_PUBLIC_WEB_URL}: PASS - exact match https://merchant-panel-sync.preview.emergentagent.com/?ref=U32QUR6 (same format as web ScanQRModule)
frontend_checks.dl-pdf on web: PASS - clicking does not crash; posterToPdf(web) calls Print.printAsync (opens print dialog / falls to toast 'Choose Save as PDF'). No JS exception.
frontend_checks.dl-print button: PASS - present and enabled (not clicked to avoid hanging headless).
frontend_checks.hero-share fallback (no navigator.share): PASS - share-modal opens, share-copy toast 'Link copied successfully', share-close dismisses
frontend_checks.hero-whatsapp fallback (headless): PASS - triggers poster PNG download azoapp-poster-U32QUR6.png (329229 bytes) then opens wa.me popup; no crash. Matches web fallback (webDownload + window.open in posterActions.ts).
frontend_checks.booking-logic parity: PASS - QR encodes and hero-link renders the same string web uses: `${window.location.origin}/?ref=${merchant_code}` (WEB_ORIGIN taken from EXPO_PUBLIC_WEB_URL).

console_warnings: Animated useNativeDriver not supported on web (RN-web expected)

critical_code_review_comments: posterActions.ts sharePosterFile web path correctly probes navigator.canShare({files}) first, then falls back to webDownload+wa.me for whatsapp — verified working in headless.
posterToPdf(web) opens print dialog and returns null; scanqr.tsx handles null by showing toast 'Choose Save as PDF in the print dialog'. No crash.

Native PDF path (printToFileAsync -> moveAsync to readable name -> openPosterFile with Android VIEW intent) is guarded by Platform checks and cannot be exercised on web; code paths look correct and are protected with try/catch fallback to Sharing.shareAsync.
hero-link uses process.env.EXPO_PUBLIC_WEB_URL || MEDIA_ORIGIN and matches web format exactly. Web panel /?ref=U32QUR6 returns 200 — booking logic parity confirmed.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Expo web served by Metro on http://localhost:8081. Flow: onboard-skip -> skip-notifications-button -> demo-merchant -> tab-scanqr. All Scan QR interactive elements have data-testid. Native-only code paths (Android SAF, VIEW intent PDF open, react-native-share) cannot be validated on web; code review shows they are guarded with Platform.OS checks and try/catch fallbacks (Sharing.shareAsync + Clipboard caption + Linking to whatsapp://). Backend regression is stable.
